column1: # applications components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Ids are desktop files; enter launches the selection and closes (for a popup bound in the window manager),
mode    apps         -       desktop entries by name                                 default
toggle  hidden       alt-h   entries marked NoDisplay or Hidden too (dim)            -
action  launch       -       launch (gtk-launch, detached), then close               become,default
action  launch-stay  ctrl-o  launch (gtk-launch, detached)                           silent
action  edit         alt-e   edit the desktop files                                  foreground,reload
action  copy         ctrl-y  copy the desktop IDs                                    silent,builtin
action  copy-exec    alt-Y   copy the Exec lines                                     notify
